M20 benchmark artifacts

This folder holds sample benchmark-oriented artifacts for the mode comparison harness.

Current contents:

- `sample_benchmark_report.json`: example JSON-first report shape emitted by `backend/app/eval/compare_eval.py`
- `sample_comparison_notes.md`: example human-readable notes format for documenting when enriched modes help or do not help

This folder is for inspectable benchmark outputs and examples.
It is not a production runtime surface.
